values.note: Single site $22 a night (FS page, updated May 5, 2026), charged for the full-service summer period; fees at some areas are not charged in early spring and late fall. Day-use/boat launch $5 per vehicle, not charged to campers.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/pomeroy-lake-campground ('Single Site: $22 per night'; 'Fees shown are for the summer recreation period when full services are provided. During the early spring and late fall when no services are provided the fees at some areas are not charged.'; 'Day use/boat launch - $5/vehicle/day ... Day use fees will not be charged to those who have already paid for a campground campsite.'; 'Last updated May 5, 2026'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 2026: reduced services from October 15 (no water or garbage); usable until snow limits access or January 1, whichever comes first. Gates close as soon as snow starts to accumulate.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/pomeroy-lake-campground ('Seasons of Use May 15 – October 15'; 'Reduced services beginning October 15, 2026, no water or garbage services will be provided. Visitors can use the facility until snow conditions reduce access or January 1st, whichever is sooner.'; 'Gates get closed as soon as snow starts to accumulate.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: No reservations: claim a site in person and self-pay; on site you may be able to pay with the Recreation.gov app's Scan and Pay (download it first: cell service is limited). Campers must occupy the site the first night. Run by a concessionaire, Camp Host, LLC.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/pomeroy-lake-campground ('No reservations- first come, first serve.'; 'Hours of Operation: 24 hours - self pay'; 'Camping in a developed recreation site is allowed for a period not longer than 14 days'; 'Campers must occupy the site the first night'; 'Contact Name: Camp Host, LLC') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10192127 ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site ... Scan and Pay'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: One loop of 11 drive-in sites that 'can accommodate tents, trailers, and motorhomes', screened by natural vegetation; each has a picnic table, fire ring and parking spur. One RV or camper trailer per site; no length posted.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/pomeroy-lake-campground ('The campground consists of one camping loop with 11 campsites ... This campground provides drive-in sites that can accommodate tents, trailers, and motorhomes. Each site offers a picnic table, fire ring, and parking spur.'; 'No. of Sites: 11'; 'a maximum of one RV or camper trailer and two tents per camping site'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: One double vault toilet and a central hand pump. No water or garbage service after the October service cutoff.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/pomeroy-lake-campground ('One double vault toilet is located centrally in the campground and water is provided by a centrally located hand pump'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-25

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/pomeroy-lake-campground ('Golden Age/Interagency Senior and Access passes accepted'), read 2026-10-25

note: Ottawa NF campground beside Pomeroy Lake on the Bessemer Ranger District, 8 mi SE of Marenisco, reached from US 2 via FR 7300, CR 525, FR 6828 and FR 6828A. Concrete boat ramp (no fee) next to the campground for the lake's pike, walleye, bass and musky. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov (FCFS-only Scan and Pay listing, no rates or campsite catalog) + Ottawa alerts: $22 (2026, confirmed), first-come only (confirmed), 11 drive-in sites for tents/trailers/motorhomes (confirmed), 14-night limit, vault toilet, hand-pump water, senior/access pass (all new); season May 15 - Oct 15 with reduced services to snow/Jan 1 (new). Concessionaire Camp Host, LLC. No forest alert or order affects FR 7300 / CR 525 / FR 6828 (the only road closures were the Oct 9-10 rally near Kenton). Electric/hookups not stated. Note trimmed of field restatements.
